title: HDFC Silver ETF Fund of Fund - Monthly Scheme Factsheet

sections.content: HDFC Silver ETF Fund of Fund is an open-ended fund of fund scheme investing in HDFC Silver ETF. As of October 2026, Scheme AUM is ₹4,497.00 Crore. Direct Plan Growth NAV is ₹31.6796. Fund Managers: Nirman Morakhia and Arun Agarwal.

Total Expense Ratio (TER) for Direct Plan is 0.21% per annum. Exit load: 1.00% if redeemed or switched out within 15 days from the date of allotment. Nil exit load if redeemed after 15 days from allotment date.

Benchmark: Domestic Price of Physical Silver (based on LBMA Silver daily spot fixing). Portfolio allocation: HDFC Silver ETF units 98.50%, Debt and Money Market instruments 1.50%. Riskometer: Very High Risk. Investors do not need a demat account to invest via SIP.
